complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Audit Hook Scripts (18 ours vs 25 ECC)
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down by hook categories: 1) Create inventory script to list/compare both hook sets, 2) Audit session lifecycle hooks (session-init, session-end, pre-compact), 3) Audit file operation hooks (post-edit-format, protect-sensitive, doc-file-blocker), 4) Audit development workflow hooks (typescript-check, dev-server-blocker, build-analysis, console-log-audit), 5) Audit auxiliary hooks (suggest-compact, pattern-extraction, observe, pr-url-extract, long-running-tmux-hint), 6) Document all verdicts in hooks-decisions.md
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity. Requires comparing 18 template hooks (confirmed in .claude/hooks/ glob results) against 25 ECC hooks via gh api. Each hook comparison needs architecture analysis, feature comparison, error handling review. The task details specify 4 priority comparisons (session-init vs session-start, session-end vs session-end, dev-server-blocker vs auto-tmux-dev, doc-file-blocker vs doc-file-warning). Multiple API calls, detailed analysis, and documentation for ~15 overlapping hooks. Significant research and judgment required.
